rules.name: target
rules.what: Everything Cargo compiled for this project, for every profile and target.
rules.comeback: Cargo compiles it again on the next build. The first build afterwards takes longer.

rules.name: Cargo registry cache
rules.what: Downloaded crates and their unpacked sources, plus git dependencies.
rules.comeback: Cargo downloads crates again when a build needs them.

rules.name: Go build cache
rules.what: Compiled packages and test results the go command reuses between builds.
rules.comeback: The go command fills it again as you build and test.

rules.name: Go module cache
rules.what: Source code of every Go module you have downloaded.
rules.comeback: The go command downloads modules again when a build needs them.

rules.name: Gradle caches
rules.what: Dependencies, compiled build scripts and transforms Gradle shares across projects.
rules.comeback: Gradle downloads and rebuilds what it needs on the next build.

rules.name: Gradle wrapper distributions
rules.what: Full Gradle versions downloaded by projects' Gradle wrappers. Old versions pile up here.
rules.comeback: The wrapper downloads the version a project needs the next time it runs.

rules.name: Gradle build folders
rules.what: This project's Gradle build output and its local cache.
rules.comeback: Gradle builds it again on the next build.

rules.name: Maven local repository
rules.what: Every library Maven has downloaded. Anything you installed yourself with mvn install lives here too and needs installing again.
rules.comeback: Maven downloads dependencies again on the next build.

rules.name: target
rules.what: Maven's build output for this project.
rules.comeback: Maven builds it again with mvn package or mvn install.
